attributes.review: I love the ability that this app gives me to connect to my peers and allows me to share some of the best memories that I have lived in my life. But the hours that it has taken from me because of the psychological hack that is holds on people’s minds is something that I can not support. This app left unregulated will destroy your time for yourself and your ability to live life. Irregular emotions, attention spans, and your self worth are all major things that this app is affecting in the background. I think the app is very successful and amazing at what it was designed to do, and almost no one can live without it. But for the reasons stated above, this app does not deserve to be a public favorite.
attributes.title: Addictive by Nature
